page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s3.large is an x86_64 architecture virtual machine instance operating on the KVM hypervisor. It is configured with 4 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 4 physical cores with a single thread per core, meaning hyperthreading is disabled. The instance is equipped with 8.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 2.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware, requiring external block storage for operating system and application data.

With dedicated CPU allocation and a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, this instance type provides predictable compute performance without the resource contention typical of shared-core or burstable configurations. The absence of bundled local storage and GPUs positions this server as a cost-efficient option for workloads that rely on network-attached storage and do not require hardware acceleration. It is suitable for compute-focused tasks with moderate memory footprints, such as lightweight web serving, application servers, and distributed compute nodes.
